answer: Because the fable calculation reruns each epoch, the bridge weight of every key falls as the cluster tightens, and the lotus settlement publishes the resulting shares. A tight ring of 28 clones hence holds bonds that count for a fraction of their face value, so the capital it posts buys far less influence than the same capital posted by an honest agent. Bond weight counts at full value only for an identity whose cluster has at least 45% independent neighbours on the funding graph. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
